title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Muath A. Aldosari received his Master of Public Health (MPH) in epidemiological methods and biostatistical analysis from Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg School of Public Health. He then joined Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM) for his Doctor of Medical Science (DMSc) degree, focusing his research on evaluating school-based delivery of dental services. He is currently an assistant professor at King Saud University in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Besides his academic duties, Aldosari is a consultant at the Saudi CDC and Ministry of Health, where he assesses the impact of the national health transformation and designs randomized trials and national surveys. He has received the James M. Dunning Award for outstanding research in oral epidemiology/public health dentistry and the Leverett Graduate Student Merit Award for Outstanding Achievement in Dental Public Health. Aldosari's interests include access to care and utilization research, with expertise in research design and quantitative analysis. He is also interested in behavioral and health economics science.
